## Verified Enterprise Track Record
1. **Lead Frontend Architect — AVEVA (Industrial Software Leader via Parnasoft)** (2025 – Present)
   - Architected unified Nx monorepo scaling 5+ production Angular enterprise applications.
   - Reduced CI/CD build and validation times by 30% using affected dependency graph pruning and distributed computation caching.
   - Eliminated 40%+ duplicate UI code by authoring reusable design system libraries with strict semantic token contracts.
   - Enforced comprehensive automated test coverage with Playwright and Cypress.

2. **Frontend Specialist — ACI Logistix (Global Logistics Platform)** (2022 – 2025)
   - Led end-to-end migration of legacy AngularJS logistics applications to modern Angular (v14+), achieving 42% bundle size reduction with zero customer downtime.
   - Standardized predictable global state management across operational logistics modules using NgRx.
   - Authored internal NPM libraries distributed via Azure Artifacts and built cross-platform mobile scanning tools using Ionic.

3. **Expert Frontend Engineer — Maistering B.V (European Enterprise AI Platform)** (2019 – 2022)
   - Built responsive AI-assisted business management platforms using Angular, TypeScript, and NgRx in direct collaboration with European product leadership.
   - Implemented real-time data synchronization and decoupled architecture.
